entries.text: FlightData queries for PostgreSQL are rendered by `translate_sql_query` with the runtime's `round_inputs_to_decimal` rewrite instead of local AST code; the `ast_rewrite` allowlist entry for `benchbox/core/flightdata/queries.py` is gone. The ROUND casts are unchanged, but the PostgreSQL text no longer quotes identifiers (`translate_sql_query` does not quote for `postgres`), so `"f"."dep_delay"` is now `f.dep_delay`. All 20 queries execute on PostgreSQL 16.2 before and after. No published FlightData bundle targets PostgreSQL, so no published result changes.
